SECRET

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTRY No. S. B. N. 612/41 Special Branch 30th Jan 41）
Date January 28, 1941

Subject William F. Kimfull.

Made by D. S. Cornwell Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

William F. Kimfull, aged 45, is known to have resided in Shanghai during 1940. He has made several journeys to Nagasaki. He returned from Nagasaki on January 17th, 1941 but his present address is not known.

He is not registered at H.B.M. Passport Office and H.B.M. Consulate have no records concerning him. He is likewise unknown to the British Chamber of Commerce.

William F. Kimfull is known to the S.M.P. and the French Police as an associate of members of a narcotic gang and he was a suspect in the early part of 1940 in connection with a large jewel robbery in the French Concession.

Nothing is known by the S.M.P. as to William F. Kimfull's present financial status although he has at times resided in the Park Hotel where he registered as a British subject from Lewisham, London, England.

（批：P.A. (C J Paris)）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

D. S.
A. C. (Special Branch)

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科登记号 S. B. N. 612/41 特务科 1941年1月30日）
日期：1941年1月28日

事由：威廉·F·金富尔（William F. Kimfull）。

撰写人：D. S. Cornwell 转呈人：D. I. Crawford

威廉·F·金富尔，45岁，已知其于1940年间居住在上海。他曾多次前往长崎。他于1941年1月17日从长崎返回，但其目前住址不详。

他未在大英帝国护照办公室注册，大英帝国领事馆亦无关于他的记录。英国商会同样不知此人。

上海公共租界工部局警务处及法国巡捕房均知悉威廉·F·金富尔与某毒品团伙成员有往来，且他在1940年初曾作为法租界一起重大珠宝抢劫案的嫌疑人受到调查。

上海公共租界工部局警务处对威廉·F·金富尔目前的财务状况一无所知，尽管他有时居住在国际饭店，并在那里登记为来自英国伦敦刘易舍姆（Lewisham）的英籍人士。

（批注：P.A. (C J Paris)）
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）

D. S.
助理总监（特务科）

他未在大英帝国护照办公室注册，大英帝国领事馆亦无关于他的记录。英国商会同样不知此人。

威廉·F·金富尔为上海公共租界工部局警务处及法国巡捕房所熟知，系某毒品团伙成员的关联人，且他在1940年初曾作为法租界一起重大珠宝抢劫案的嫌疑人受到调查。

CONFIDENTIAL.

The Commissioner of Police,
Police Force,
Shanghai Municipal ...,
100, Nanking Road,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir,

Mr. William F. Kimfull.

I have received the following telegram from Mr.
J. D'Arcy McGreer, Chargé d'Affaires, Canadian Legation,
Tokyo:-

"Please telegraph immediately if obtainable
"address of William F. Kimfull allegedly
"Canadian exporter and importer in Shanghai
"and forward by letter statement concerning
"his financial status and reliability"

As I have no knowledge of Mr. William F. Kimfull
and cannot trace any record of him in our office files or
in any of the local directories, I shall be very much obliged
if you can give me any information concerning him. It is
possible that the name may be "Kimbull" as there were two
mistakes in the telegram when received, so if you cannot
trace anyone of the name of "...mfull" perhaps you will be
good enough to check up on anyone of the name of "William
F. Kimbull".

Your prompt reply will be much appreciated in view
of the fact that Mr. McGreer has asked for a telegraphic
reply.

Yours faithfully,

（签名）
(M. T. Stewart)
Acting Canadian Trade Commissioner

我收到加拿大驻东京公使馆代办 J. D'Arcy McGreer 先生发来的如下电报：

“如能获取，请立即电告
“据称为上海加拿大进出口商
“威廉·F·金富尔的地址
“并以信函形式报送关于
“其财务状况及可靠性的陈述”

由于我对威廉·F·金富尔先生一无所知，且在我处档案或任何本地名录中均无法查到他的记录，若蒙阁下提供有关他的任何信息，我将不胜感激。名字有可能是“Kimbull”，因为收到电报时有两处错误，因此如果您查不到名为“...mfull”的人，或许劳驾您核查一下是否有名为“William F. Kimbull”的人。

鉴于 McGreer 先生要求电报回复，如蒙迅速赐复，将不胜感激。

此致，

（签名）
(M. T. Stewart)
加拿大代理贸易专员
